projects.name: Kotwica
projects.description: Raspberry Pi hub in the basement: MQTT sensors (ESP32, DS18B20), boiler relay, heating schedule with cheap-tariff pre-heating, presence detection, vacation mode, wall-switch fallback.

projects.name: Latarnik
projects.description: A novel about a lighthouse keeper (Anzelm) on a fictional island, plus the writer's toolkit: chapter versions as events, continuity checker for characters/timeline, word-count stats, epub export.

projects.name: Fakturka
projects.description: Invoicing tool for his wife Halina's ceramics shop: gapless numbering, VAT per rate, PDF, corrections instead of edits, advance invoices, CSV for the accountant.

foundations.name: storage layer
foundations.description: Append-only event store on SQLite, forward-only migrations, upcasting on read.

foundations.name: plugin system
foundations.description: Folder-scanned plugins with manifest + declared capabilities; fault isolation.

foundations.name: event bus
foundations.description: In-process pub/sub, queue per subscriber, idempotent handlers, outbox.

principles.statement_pl: Wybieraj nudne, sprawdzone technologie zamiast nowinek.
principles.statement_en: Prefer boring, proven technology over novelty.

principles.statement_pl: Nigdy nie kasuj ani nie nadpisuj danych - dopisuj; stan to widok na historie.
principles.statement_en: Never delete or overwrite data - append; state is a view over history.

principles.statement_pl: Kazda automatyka musi miec reczny tryb dzialajacy bez niej (test: trzecia w nocy, bez internetu).
principles.statement_en: Every automation needs a manual mode that works without it (the 3 a.m. offline test).

principles.statement_pl: Buduj male klocki z wyraznymi granicami, wymienialne w jeden wieczor.
principles.statement_en: Build small pieces with clear borders, replaceable in one evening.
Record the why, not the what.

principles.statement_pl: Dane w otwartych formatach, do odczytania zwyklym notatnikiem za 20 lat; zadnego vendor locka.
principles.statement_en: Data in open formats readable by a plain editor in 20 years; no vendor lock-in.

principles.statement_pl: Brzydka, skonczona pierwsza wersja w ~14 dni; polerka dopiero potem; obcinaj zakres zamiast przedluzac.
principles.statement_en: Ship an ugly, finished first version in ~14 days; polish later; cut scope instead of extending.

decisions.statement: Wall switch bypasses all electronics; automation is an add-on, not a pillar.
Every chapter save is an event; current text = latest, history retained.
Invoice numbers are assigned at commit inside a transaction, drafts have none.
Issued invoices are never edited; a correcting document references the original.
Accountant export: CSV, semicolon, UTF-8 BOM, decimal comma, document number as text.
One SQLite file per project via a shared event-store library; domain lives in payloads.
Schema changes via PRAGMA user_version, forward-only, file copy before migrating.
Plugins live in a folder with manifest.toml and declared capabilities + core API version.
Plugin calls are wrapped with timeout; N consecutive failures disable the plugin.
In-process bus with hierarchical topics; one queue per subscriber.
Handlers are idempotent; subscriber offsets are stored in the same transaction as effects.
Event + to-send marker written in one transaction; a separate worker publishes.
Shared core is a versioned package with contract tests run in each project's CI.
Final invoice carries full value and a negative line for advances.
Old event versions are upcast in memory on read; stored events are never rewritten.
Snapshots are a rebuildable cache carrying the last event hash; the old log is archived, never deleted.
Core never imports from domain code; CI enforces the dependency direction.
